dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL as part of the JMA ORCA project. Uses MCP-based screen handling (MCPAREA, MCPDATA) typical of ORCA's GUI framework.

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software – system management information setting screen for receipt printing / public expense entry order configuration (W122 screen)
purpose.summary: This program implements the W122 screen of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system, handling the configuration of public-expense (公費) entry order settings for receipt printing. It manages screen initialization, SPA (screen parameter area) setup, list display of head/body items, and transitions to confirmation dialogs (WID1). It is a subprogram called via the ORCA MCP framework with LINK/PUTG events.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (70 copybooks) for screen layouts and data structures
MCP-based GUI framework (MCPAREA, MCP-STATUS, MCP-EVENT, MCP-WINDOW)
OCCURS tables for head/body list management
Japanese text in comments (EUC-JP encoded, displayed as latin-1 mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS – uses proprietary MCPDATA DB access
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen control
SPA (Screen Parameter Area) pattern for state persistence across calls
verdict.notes: Comments contain Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP, decoded here as latin-1 resulting in mojibake. File is part of the open-source JMA ORCA project. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 84327 bytes (2090 lines total); full procedure division not visible but structure is clear. No COMP-3 usage despite being a production medical system – likely uses character-based arithmetic or relies on copybook definitions.
